definitions.full: H2351. chuts חוּץ noun [masculine] the outside , sometimes, especially in plural, specifically a street, never with suffix in singular, with ָ ה locative חֻ֫צָה ח֫וּצָה, , plural חֻצוֺת חוּצוֺת, , with suffix חוּצֹתָיו etc., Isa 15:3 etc.; — 1 the outside , of a house, tent, city, camp, etc., often used, especially with prepositions, to express the adverb idea of outside, abroad (Aramaic synonym, except in sense 2a , is בַּר , ): a. as accusative after verb of motion Deut 23:13 חוּץ יָצָא to go forth outside (that is, a camp), 23:14 (as adverb accusative) חוּץ בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ outside , הַחוּץ הוֺצִיא to bring forth outside (a house or chamber) Judg 19:25 ; 2Sam 13:18 compare Neh 13:8 ; Judg 12:9 b מִןהַֿחוּץ לְבָנָיו הֵבִיא בָּנוֺת from outside , from abroad , 2Kin 4:3 מִןהַֿחוּץ כֵּלִים שַׁאֲלִילָֿךְ from outside (opposed to בַּבַּיִת 4:2 ); as Genitive Lev 18:9 חוּץ מוֺלֶדֶת one born abroad (i.e. by another father or mother, of a half-sister: opposed to בַּיִת מוֺלֶדֶת ) Ezek 47:2 (twice in verse). With ָ ה locative חוּצָה , after a verb of motion Exod 12:46 חוּצָה ֗֗֗ מִןהַֿבַּיִת , Prov 5:16 ; 2Chr 29:16 , 33:15 לָעִיר חוּצָה outside of the city, Num 35:4 וָחוּצָה הָעִיר מִקִּיר from the wall of the city and outwards ; = on the outside, without 1Kin 6:6 ; Isa 33:7 חוּצָה צָֽעֲקוּ cry without , 2Chr 24:8 : so הַחוּצָה Gen 15:5 הח אֹתוֺ ׳וַיּוֺצֵא and brought him outside , 19:17 ; 24:29 ; Josh 2:19 +, 1Kin 8:8 הַחוּצָה יֵרָאוּ לֹא were not seen towards the outside , Deut 25:5 זָר לְאִישׁ הַחוּצָה הַמֵּת אֵשֶׁת תִהְיֶה לֹא i.e. shall not be married into another family, compare Judg 12:9 a. b. with preps .: a. אלהֿחוץ towards the outside Ezek 41:9 , 34:21 pleonastic אלהֿחוצה . b. בחוץ Gen 9:22 outside (opposed to אָהֳלֹה בְּתוֺךְ 9:21 ), 24:31 בַּחוץ תַעֲמֹד לָמָּה , Deut 24:11 ; Exod 21:19 בחוץ והתהלך יקום אם (after leaving a sick couch), 2Kin 10:24 ; Psa 31:12 ; Ezek 7:15 (opposed to מִבַּיִת ), Hosea 7:1 +. c. לחוץ Psa 41:7 לחוץ יצא ; = on the outside Ezek 41:17 ; 42:7 , לַחוּצָה 2Chr 32:5 towards the outside . d. מִחוּץ on ( מִן 3c ) the outside Ezek 40:19 ; 46:2 , וּמִחוּץ מִבַיִת within and without (of an ark, building, etc.) Gen 6:14 ; Exod 25:11 = 37:2 ; 1Kin 7:9 ; Deut 32:25 תְּשַׁכֶּלחֶֿרֶב מחוץ (opposed to אֵימָה יּמֵחֲדָרִים ), Lam 1:20 (compare Ezek 7:15 above b ); so מֵהַחוּץ 41:25 . לְ מִחוּץ on the outside of , Gen 19:16 לָעִיר מִחוּץ וַיַּנִּיחֵהוּ , 24:11 ; Exod 26:35 ; 37:7 (twice in verse); Lev 8:17 ; 14:8 ; Num 35:5 ; Josh 6:23 ; Jer 21:4 +, even after a verb of motion 1Kin 21:13 לְעִיר מִחוּץ וַיּוֺצִיאוּהוּ , 2Kin 23:6 , though in this case מחוץל אל is more common, Lev 4:12 , 21 למחנה מחוץ אל , 6:4 ; 10:4 ; 14:40-41 , + often P, Deut 23:11 . e. מִחוּצָה Ezek 40:40 on the outside , לְ מִחוּצָה 40:44 . f. (late) מִן חוּץ outside of , Eccl 2:25 who can eat, and who enjoy, מִמֶּנִּיִ חוּץ outside of me, i.e. except me? (but read rather, with ᵑ6 ᵐ5 De Now and others, מִמֶּנּוּ חוּץ apart from, without him, i.e. God). Jeremiah; 1Kin 20:34 בְּדַמֶּשֶׂק תָּשִׂיםלְֿךָ וְחֻצוֺת and streets (i.e. bazaars) shalt thou make thee in D., as my father made in Samaria (a concession involving the right of trading), Amos 5:16 ; Isa 15:3 ; 24:11 (as scene of mourning), 5:25 ; Jer 51:4 ; Ezek 11:6 ; 28:23 ( as filled with corpses of slain), כָּלחֿוּצוֺת בְּראֹשׁ i.e. in conspicuous places, Nahum 3:10 ; Lam 2:19 ; 4:1 ; Isa 51:20 , חוּצוֺת טִיט mire of streets Zech 10:5 (trampled on by warriors), in simile, of foes trodden under foot, Psa 18:43 ; Micah 7:10 ( so ח ׳כְּחֹמֶר Isa 10:6 ), metaphor of cheapness and abundance Zech 9:3 . b. more Generally, that which is outside enclosed cities, the open country , Job 18:17 עַלמְּֿנֵיחֿוּץ לוֺ שֵׁם וְלאֹ (see De), compare Prov 24:27 ; in the plural Job 5:10 חוּצוֺת פְנֵי עַל מַיִם וְשֹׁלֵחַ , Prov 8:26 ; Psa 144:13 (as place where flocks abound).
